summary: STIFTELSEN MELAND GOLF & NATURPARK (org. no. 977 550 084) is a foundation (STI) based in Alver, in the Brønnøysund registers since 1997-08-06. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 94.992 (Aktiviteter i andre medlemsorganisasjoner ellers); it has 0 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 1.4 m and net income was NOK 219 699. Board chair: Øystein Varden; auditor: ARETO REVISJON AS.
